title: Fractions & Percentages
description: Working with parts of a whole and converting between fractions, decimals, and percentages.

notes.heading: Equivalent Fractions and Simplifying
notes.body: Equivalent fractions represent the same amount: 1/2=2/4=4/8. To simplify, divide numerator and denominator by their HCF. Example: 12/18 → HCF=6 → 2/3.

notes.heading: Adding and Multiplying Fractions
notes.body: To add/subtract: find common denominator (LCM). Multiply fractions: multiply numerators together, denominators together. (2/3)×(4/5)=8/15. Always simplify.

notes.heading: Percentages and Conversions
notes.body: Percent = "out of 100". Fraction → percentage: numerator÷denominator×100. 3/4=75%. Percentage of amount: convert to decimal and multiply. 20% of 60 = 0.20×60 = 12.

flashcards.definition: The top number — how many parts you have.
The bottom number — how many equal parts the whole is divided into.
